question: 请列出所有客户的首次下单日期、最近一次下单日期、有效订单总次数以及使用的不同支付方式数量，按客户ID升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对每个用户（users.user_id）计算：最早order_date（MIN(orders.order_date)）、最晚order_date（MAX(orders.order_date)）、在valid orders（order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')）中的订单数（COUNT）、所用不同payment_method种类数（COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method)），结果按user_id ASC排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.payment_method) AS distinct_payment_method_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY u.user_id ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计每个客户等级（user_level）下，客户平均有效订单次数、平均使用支付方式数，以及该等级内至少下过3次有效订单的客户占比，按客户等级升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.user_level分组，计算：该等级下所有客户的平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该等级中valid_order_count >= 3 的客户占该等级总客户数的比例（ROUND(COUNT_IF(valid_order_count>=3)/COUNT(*),4)），结果按user_level ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_level, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.valid_order_count >= 3 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_customers_with_at_least_3_orders FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.user_level ORDER BY u.user_level ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2026年9月12日之前注册、且至少完成过1次有效订单的客户，返回其用户ID、注册日期、首次下单日期、有效订单总次数及是否为VIP（is_vip），按注册日期升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（on user_id），筛选users.register_date < '2026-09-12' 且 orders.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')，对每个用户取MIN(order_date)为首次下单日、COUNT(*)为有效订单次数，返回user_id, register_date, first_order_date, valid_order_count, is_vip，按register_date ASC排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.register_date, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, u.is_vip FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') WHERE u.register_date < '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.register_date, u.is_vip ORDER BY u.register_date ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各城市中，客户平均有效订单次数、平均不同支付方式数、以及该城市客户中使用超过2种支付方式的比例，按城市名称升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.city分组，计算：该城市所有客户的平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该城市中distinct_payment_count > 2 的客户数占该城市总客户数的比例（ROUND(COUNT_IF(distinct_payment_count>2)/COUNT(*),4)），结果按city ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.distinct_payment_count > 2 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_customers_using_more_than_2_payment_methods FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY u.city ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2026年9月12日前完成过至少2次有效订单、且使用过微信和支付宝两种支付方式的客户，返回其用户ID、用户姓名、注册日期、有效订单次数及使用的支付方式列表（逗号分隔），按注册日期降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（valid orders），GROUP BY user_id，HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('wechat','alipay') THEN payment_method END)=2；用GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT payment_method ORDER BY payment_method)生成支付方式列表；返回user_id, user_name, register_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, payment_list；按register_date DESC排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.register_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.payment_method ORDER BY o.payment_method SEPARATOR ',') AS payment_list FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.register_date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.payment_method IN ('wechat','alipay') THEN o.payment_method END) = 2 ORDER BY u.register_date DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各客户等级（user_level）中，首末订单时间跨度（天数）大于30天的客户占比、平均订单频次（有效订单数/注册天数）、以及该等级客户平均使用支付方式数，按客户等级升序排列。
intended_meaning: 对每个用户，计算：first_order_date、last_order_date、注册天数（DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date)+1）、订单跨度（DATEDIFF(last_order_date, first_order_date)）；按user_level分组，计算：该等级中订单跨度>30天的客户占比（ROUND(COUNT_IF(span>30)/COUNT(*),4)）、平均订单频次（SUM(valid_order_count)*1.0/SUM(reg_days)）、平均支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）；结果按user_level ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_level, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.span > 30 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_span_gt30_days, ROUND(SUM(t.valid_order_count) * 1.0 / SUM(t.reg_days), 4) AS avg_order_frequency_per_reg_day, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_method FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count, DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', MIN(order_date)) AS span, DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', u2.register_date) + 1 AS reg_days FROM orders o INNER JOIN users u2 ON o.user_id = u2.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.user_level ORDER BY u.user_level ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2026年9月12日当天或之前有下单记录、且有效订单次数不少于5次的客户，返回其用户ID、城市、客户等级、首次下单日期、最近一次下单日期及有效订单总次数，按有效订单次数降序、用户ID升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（order_date <= '2026-09-12' 且 order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')），GROUP BY user_id, city, user_level，HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5；返回user_id, city, user_level, MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date), COUNT(*)；ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, user_id ASC；LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.city, u.user_level, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id, u.city, u.user_level HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各性别客户中，平均有效订单次数、平均不同支付方式数、以及该性别中使用过全部三种主流支付方式（alipay/wechat/card）的客户占比，按性别升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.gender分组，计算：平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该性别中payment_method集合包含'alipay','wechat','card'三者的客户数占比（ROUND(COUNT_IF(has_all_three)/COUNT(*),4)），其中has_all_three通过检查GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT payment_method)是否含全部三个值判断；结果按gender ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.gender, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.has_all_three THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_has_alipay_wechat_card FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('alipay','wechat','card') THEN payment_method END) = 3 AS has_all_three FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY u.gender ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2025年1月1日后注册、且首末订单时间跨度超过180天的客户，返回其用户ID、注册日期、首次下单日期、最近一次下单日期、有效订单次数及是否为VIP，按首末订单跨度降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（valid orders），筛选register_date > '2025-01-01'，GROUP BY user_id等关键字段，计算span = DATEDIFF(MAX(order_date), MIN(order_date))，HAVING span > 180；返回user_id, register_date, MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date), COUNT(*), is_vip；ORDER BY span DESC, user_id ASC；LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.register_date, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, u.is_vip FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') WHERE u.register_date > '2025-01-01' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.register_date, u.is_vip HAVING DATEDIFF(MAX(o.order_date), MIN(o.order_date)) > 180 ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MAX(o.order_date), MIN(o.order_date)) DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各省份中，客户平均有效订单次数、平均不同支付方式数、以及该省份中同时使用过线上（alipay/wechat）和线下（card/cash）支付方式的客户占比，按省份升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.province分组，计算：平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该省份中既使用过线上支付（alipay或wechat）又使用过线下支付（card或cash）的客户占比（ROUND(COUNT_IF(has_online AND has_offline)/COUNT(*),4)），其中has_online和has_offline分别通过CASE聚合判断；结果按province ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.province, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.has_online AND t.has_offline THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_has_online_and_offline FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count, MAX(CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('alipay','wechat') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_online, MAX(CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('card','cash') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_offline FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.province ORDER BY u.province ASC;
